notes.title: Playtests, Feedback, and What’s Next - Devlog 2
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, Mark here again. Welcome back to the second Devlog for [i]Bloodstone Rising[/i]![/p][p]Today, I want to delve into something equally important: playtests, feedback, and how you can contribute to shaping the game.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Why Playtests Matter[/h2][p]I can spend weeks coding features, tweaking combat, and building systems, but the real test happens when someone else picks up the game and plays it their way. [/p][p]That’s when the unexpected shows up: strategies I never thought of and feedback I wouldn’t have considered on my own.[/p][p]This kind of feedback helped shape the new version of the first Boss, which now has more mechanics, attacks, and is more challenging.[/p][p]That’s the magic of playtesting: it turns Bloodstone Rising into something greater than the sum of its parts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585643/2ca56292d4a38d9e832899fe7e94ae8ecd9220b4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]How to Give Feedback[/h2][p]I want feedback to be as easy and open as possible. [/p][p]Here are the main ways you can help:[/p][p]• Discord feedback channel – The best place to drop quick thoughts, screenshots, or funny bugs
• Steam discussions – Perfect for longer write-ups and suggestions
• Playtest reports – For those in the closed playtest, I’ll share a short survey after each testing round[/p][p]Whether it’s a one-line “shotgun feels weak” or a full breakdown of your run, every bit of input helps me tune the game closer to what players want.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585643/21d75f99ae05e58da234369b80bb04b8f8423947.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Playtesters Wanted[/h2][p]If you’re reading this and you’re curious about Bloodstone Rising, now’s your chance to jump in. Playtest sign-ups are planned to come, and spots will be limited.[/p][p]Playtesters get:
• Early access to new builds before public demo updates
• A chance to directly influence game balance and features
• Tester bragging rights in the community[/p][p]Keep an eye on the communications for potential sign-ups in the coming weeks.[/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/CMHUNyRk" style="button"]Join our Community Server[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3338020/Bloodstone_Rising/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Bloodstone Rising will be a part of the Debut Festival this week!
notes.content: [h2]Bloodstone Rising will be a part of the Debut Festival this week![/h2][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [i]Bloodstone Rising[/i] will be part of this year’s [b]Steam Debut Festival[/b]. If you haven’t jumped in yet, or if it’s been a while, now’s the perfect time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585643/e064735b38d369615f18f6c9124dd45f3f3ac317.png"][/img][/p][h2]Play the updated demo[/h2][h3]Try new weapons, mechanics, and improved combat![/h3][p][/p][h3][b]The latest demo update includes:[/b][/h3][h3][b] [/b]Updates & Improvements [/h3][list][*][p] [b]Improved boss fight[/b]: The Boss now has an additional attack and is more aggressive. [/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585643/56d7eff5ff7f29200fc6b56f0edb7f68df73b2c2.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p] Balanced enemy spawns during the boss fight.[/p][/*][*][p] Balanced boss health [/p][/*][*][p] Sprinter enemy added. [/p][/*][*][p] Improved jump animation. [/p][/*][*][p] Improved pickaxe animation. [/p][/*][*][p] Adjusted the layout of multiple dungeon rooms. [/p][/*][*][p] Various animation and AI tweaks. [/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes [/h3][list][*][p] Fixed enemies sometimes attacking downed players. [/p][/*][*][p] Reduced the chance of enemies getting stuck[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585643/2ca56292d4a38d9e832899fe7e94ae8ecd9220b4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist and download now to play the Demo![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
